newsitem.title: INDIA: Truck accident kills at least 70 India pilgrims.
newsitem.headline: Truck accident kills at least 70 India pilgrims.

text.p: A truck carrying heavy boulders ran off the road and overturned in a pond killing at least 70 Hindu pilgrims riding on top, witnesses said on Tuesday.
The boulders toppled on to the passengers, mostly women, who were returning from a pilgrimage in the eastern Indian state of Bihar late on Monday.
"The truck fell into the pond after veering off the narrow road," a police official told Reuters in Sigiriyama village.
"The victims were returning from a pilgrimage to Deogarh to celebrate the acquisition of the new truck," he said, adding that at least 70 pilgrims died.
The Press Trust of India said 82 of 150 passengers were killed in the accident in Sigiriya, 35 km (22 miles) from Patna, Bihar's state capital.
Many Hindus offer prayers when they buy a vehicle, often decorating them with garlands.

"When the owner of the truck, a driver himself, acquired the vehicle, it became cause for celebrations," a rescue worker quoted one of the survivors as saying. "A large number of the driver's friends joined in, little knowing of their fate."
Witnesses said the truck had picked up a cargo of boulders on its return journey from the temple town of Deogarh.
"When it overturned, the victims were trapped under the boulders and the water in the pond," a police constable said.
He said most of the vicitms were women.
"There were a dozen children among the dead," he added.
